# Project Title

A sample project for testing documentation sync.

## Installation

```bash
npm install sample-pkg
```

## Usage

Run the following command:

```javascript
import { run } from 'sample-pkg';
run({ verbose: true });
```

### Configuration

| Option | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| verbose | boolean | false |
| timeout | number | 3000 |

> [!NOTE]
> Make sure Node 20 is installed.

Current version is v0.1.0. See [Website](https://example.com/project) and ![Logo](https://example.com/logo.png).
